data.name: Izzaat
data.gender_notes: Izzaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name that signifies the feeling of honor, respect and grace. It is a name for a girl that is admired and revered, and is given the respect and dignity that she deserves. The name Izzaat carries the meaning “Dignity, Respect” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Izzaat usually hope their child will grow to embody dignity, respect and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the inner dignity and respect that one holds for oneself and for others. It is a name that reflects the moral and ethical values of the individual, and is a reminder of the importance of treating others with respect and compassion.
data.etymology: Izzaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dignity, Respect.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Izzaat total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_urdu.name: عزت
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزت نام کی اصطلاح عربی زبان سے لی گئی ہے، جس کی معنی ہیں وقار، شان، اور طاقت۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے اور اکثر اس کا انتخاب اسلامی قوانین کے مطابق کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इज़्ज़त
in_hindi.long_meaning: इज़्ज़त नाम का अर्थ सम्मान, ताकत और प्रतिष्ठा है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका उपयोग हिंदू और मुस्लिम समुदायों में किया जाता है। यह नाम व्यक्ति की गरिमा और आत्म-सम्मान को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: عزت
in_pashto.long_meaning: عزت د نوم مطلب د پښتو ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د درنښت، قوت، او شهرت څخه عبارت دی. دا نوم په افغانستان کې ډیر کارول کیږي او د پښتنو دودیزو ارزښتونو سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Izzaat
in_english.long_meaning: The name Izzaat is derived from the Arabic root 'iz-zat', which means strength, power, and honor. It is a significant name in Islamic tradition, symbolizing dignity, respect, and prestige. The name Izzaat has been used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting the values of courage, resilience, and nobility.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Izzaat" carries a deep cultural significance in Islamic societies, as it embodies the values of honor and respect in both personal relationships and societal structures. This name is often given to a girl as a symbol of the esteem and regard that she deserves, and reminds her of the importance of upholding her own dignity as well as the respect for the dignity of others. Furthermore, it reflects the broad Islamic societal values of valuing and respecting womanhood, as well as the significance of treating all members of society with dignity and respect.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name "Izzaat" holds a deep symbolism for the Muslim community, as it represents a reminder of the inherent dignity and worth of every individual in the eyes of Allah (SWT). It speaks to the belief that all humans are endowed with the precious gift of honor and respect, regardless of their social status, race, or gender. This name serves as a reminder for Muslims to strive towards embodying the beauty of this quality in all aspects of their lives, reflecting the Quranic verse that states, "Indeed, We have honored the children of Adam" (Quran 17:70) and serving as an inspiration to uphold the command of treating others with kindness, compassion, and respect.
